Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-otros-restos-levantinos-centelles.story: From Alacón it runs 252 km to Alacón; allow about 4 h 21 of riding. On the way it passes Abrigo del Arenal de la fonseca ó Abrigo d, Centelles- Abric I and back through Abrigo del Arenal de la fonseca ó Abrigo d. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
